launch.tagline: Automations that remember, act, and keep work moving
launch.description: Computer Automations turns recurring work into reliable, ongoing workflows. Define a task once... such as monitoring sources, compiling reports, updating trackers, or drafting follow-ups... and an agent executes it on a schedule or in response to triggers. Built for professionals, teams, and operations leaders who need continuity without constant supervision, it remembers prior runs, builds on accumulated context, and acts proactively rather than waiting for a prompt.

comments.author: Rohan Chaubey
comments.text: Perplexity Computer Automations turns recurring work into proactive, long-running AI agents that run on schedules or triggers and retain context over time. Recurring work can create repetitive manual follow-ups and scattered context across tools. Automations handle ongoing tasks while carrying forward the context needed to keep work moving. Rather than treating each task as a fresh request, these agents can operate continuously and remember prior context. Features Monitor Slack, Gmail, Outlook, Linear, and GitHub. Draft customer replies, find missed updates, compare competitor pricing, update project decisions, and send work for human review. Built for Computer users managing ongoing work across projects and connected tools. Use cases : Customer communication, project tracking, competitive monitoring, decision updates, and review workflows. Set up your first standing assignment with Perplexity Computer Automations . P.S.
